Definition & Business Rules: Unique identifier for each applicant (e.g., UUID or AP-10001).
Self-reported or verified gross annual income from tax documents in USD.
Length of time with current employer in months.
Baseline credit score (FICO/VantageScore) at profile creation.
Internal risk classification. Observed values in applicants.csv: Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor.
Geographic location/market territory. Observed values in applicants.csv: Northeast, Southeast, South, Midwest, Southwest, West.
Date of birth. Validation: Current Date - birth_date >= 18.
Legal classification of work relationship. Observed values: employed, self_employed, retired.
Legal nature of residential situation. Observed values: rent, own, other.
Applicant's state abbreviation (e.g., 'NC').
Unique identifier for each individual transaction event (e.g., EV-10001).
Each credit pull is tied to a specific application and an applicant may have multiple applications.
Product Code for the loan the applicant is applying for.
Timestamp of when the credit pull event was executed.
Debt to income ratio at time of credit pull.
Score returned by bureau. Validation: Must be between 300 and 850. Can be null if pull failed.
System-calculated tier change. Values: No_Change, Upgraded, Downgraded, Not_Applicable. Rule: Use Not_Applicable if first pull or if pull failed.
Credit bureau requested. Values: EQUIFAX, EXPERIAN, TRANSUNION.
Operational result. Values: SUCCESS, FAILED, PENDING.
Reason for pull failure. Rule: Must be NULL if pull_status is SUCCESS. Observed values: RATE_LIMITED, PROVIDER ERROR, TIMEOUT, INVALID_REQUEST.
Unique tracking string returned by the provider. Used to catch duplicate responses.
Credit-tier classification recorded for the credit pull. Observed values: Low Risk, Moderate Risk, High Risk, Very High Risk.
Short identifying code for the loan product. Observed codes in loan_products.csv: MNT-01 through MNT-10 and REV-02.
Risk-status criterion associated with the product. Observed values: Low Risk, Moderate Risk, High Risk.
Baseline annual percentage rate (APR) before adjustments (e.g., 0.0550 = 5.50%).
Hard cap on the principal amount that can be issued.
Descriptive name of the credit product.
Minimum repayment term in months. Observed values in loan_products.csv: 6, 12, 24.
Maximum repayment term in months. Observed values in loan_products.csv: 24, 60, 72, 84.
Maximum permitted debt-to-income ratio represented as a percentage (e.g., 36.50 = 36.5%).
Unique identifier for each loan application record. Business constraint: each application is an individual-only application associated with exactly one applicant; co-applicants are not permitted.
References applicants.applicant_id. Cardinality constraint: each application_id must have exactly one applicant_id. A second or co-applicant must not be attached to the same application.
References product_code in loan_products.csv to map terms, base rate, and eligibility rules.

Timestamp when the loan application was submitted. Remediation moves this field from applicants.csv to loan_applications.csv because it is application-level and supports multiple applications per applicant.
Timestamp when a loan application decision is finalized. May be NULL while an application is not yet finalized (for example, Pending or Under Review).
Status of the application. Target-state values per remediation log: Approved, Denied, Under Review, Pending, Funded.
Final approved loan amount. NULL when no amount has been approved; populated for approved/funded applications as applicable.
Approved repayment term in months. NULL when no repayment term has been approved.
Foreign key referencing the underwriting policy documentation governing the decision.
Foreign key referencing the underwriting policy documentation governing the decision.
Version number of the underwriting policy identified by policy_doc_id. Added by remediation to distinguish the applicable authoritative version from superseded policy versions.
Logs the specific underwriting or eligibility rule ID that triggered the decision status.

Application activity status replacing the prior Boolean active_flag. Allowed values: Active, Inactive. Active for decision_status Approved or Funded; Inactive for decision_status Denied once 6 months have elapsed after application_date.
